theme: Judging progress involves more than passing tests
description: Participants assessed whether the requested change had been made and whether they understood the implementation, alongside test outcomes.

theme: The value of branching depends on the work being organized
description: Participants related their preference for branching or linear interaction to task size and file organization.

theme: Context separation must preserve relevant information
description: Participants discussed keeping context focused while retaining access to information needed across branches.

theme: Integration connects local progress to the shared implementation
description: Bringing separate work together involved deciding where to continue, transferring changes, and checking the combined state.

theme: Test results become instructions for the next AI action
description: Participants selected and passed test feedback to the assistant to guide the next revision.

theme: Task boundaries make progress easier to follow
description: Working on separate task parts helped participants follow the remaining work and relate failures to the part under development.
